info.name: Helm Chart Repository ChartMuseum Charts API

params.name: version
params.description: The SemVer 2 version of the chart

items.docs: Downloads a packaged Helm chart archive (.tgz file) for a specific chart name and version. The archive contains the Chart.yaml, values.yaml, templates, and other chart files. Helm clients use this endpoint after resolving chart references from the index.

params.name: version
params.description: The SemVer 2 version of the chart

items.docs: Downloads the provenance file for a specific chart version. The provenance file contains a PGP signature used to verify the integrity and origin of the chart package. This endpoint is optional and only available for cryptographically signed charts.
